name: Views Formatter
description: A Views style plugin that renders a whole View result set through a site-builder-selected Twig template, using the parent FFT module's template directory.
project_description: Views Formatter (vff) is the Views submodule of Field Formatter Template (FFT). It adds a Views style plugin, "View Formatter Template", that renders a whole Views result set through a Twig template chosen from FFT's configured template directory. Templates are authored with a {# Template Name: … #} header and a filename starting with the prefix 'views'. The style can pass either the raw rendered Views fields or the styled row data to the template, optionally build a nested tree from two id/parent-id fields, use a clean wrapper template, and render even when the View is empty.
